engine_note: Pin the exact MiniSearch version in package.json. Index is built at build time from published records (preview builds also include in_review) and served as /api/v1/search-index.json.

searchable_fields.title: tool.name | task.title + task.short_title | playbook.title | resource.title | comparison.title
searchable_fields.aliases: search_aliases joined + taxonomy aliases of assigned categories
searchable_fields.taxonomy: category labels + task family label + audience labels
searchable_fields.body: step titles + step instructions + best_for + key_capabilities text

options.prefix: true only for the last term of the query (search-as-you-type)
options.combineWith: AND; if zero results, rerun with OR and show the notice 'Showing results that match some of your words.'
options.tokenize: lowercase, split on non-alphanumerics, keep 'c++', 'c#', '.net' as tokens
options.processTerm: NFKD-normalise, strip diacritics, apply british/american spelling map, drop stopwords
options.synonym_rule: Expand each query term to itself (weight 1) plus its synonyms (weight 0.6). Synonym groups are editorial content: changes go through PR review and must not reduce the test-set score.

ranking_adjustments.effect: Pin the record whose normalised title or alias equals the normalised query to position 1.
needs_review ×0.9; archived ×0.25 (and always below non-archived results).
×1.4 for starts_without_paying=true; never a hard filter. Show a suggestion chip 'Only show options you can start without paying'.
×1.3 for records with that platform verified; suggestion chip for the platform filter.

ranking_adjustments.trigger: query has >=3 non-stopword terms or starts with how/what/where/which

ranking_adjustments.effect: No adjustment may be based on commercial relationships (D-001).

platform.values: platform ids; only verified platforms match unless include_unconfirmed=1

audience.values: audience slugs (affects result order only when chosen as a filter; never set implicitly)

facet_logic: OR within a facet, AND across facets. Facet values with zero matches are hidden unless selected.

rules: Update with history.replaceState while typing; pushState on submit or filter change, so Back returns to the previous result set.
Query max 120 chars; longer input is truncated with a visible notice.

pagination.control: 'Show more results' button appends 20; URL page param updates; focus moves to the first newly added result.

suggestions.content: Top records by title/alias prefix match, grouped as Tasks first, then Tools, then Playbooks; plus up to 2 category suggestions.

show: The query and 'No matches yet' message
Spelling suggestion (closest title/alias by edit distance <=2)
Link: Suggest something we should cover (opens the report form with issue_type=other and the query prefilled)
zero_results.analytics: search_zero_results with normalised query (see analytics events)

quality_gate.threshold: For queries with expected results: >=90% have an expected id in the top 3, and 100% of 'exact' queries have it at position 1. For 'none' queries: the AND stage returns zero results (the UI then shows either the zero-result state or the OR-fallback notice 'Showing results that match some of your words'). For 'must_not_rank_first_as_free': the highest-ranked TOOL result must have starts_without_paying=true (tasks and playbooks may rank above it).
quality_gate.ci: Run on every PR that changes content, search config or search code; fail below threshold.
quality_gate.reference_harness: search/reference-harness.mjs — a working prototype of this config on MiniSearch 7.1.2; run: node reference-harness.mjs <pack-root>. Pilot result on 2026-10-21: see search-test-set.json last_run.

scale_trigger: Re-evaluate the engine when the gzip index exceeds 400 KB or records exceed 5,000.

identity_search.purpose: Powers the 'Who are you?' entry and identity suggestions in every search box (D-046).
identity_search.index_file: /api/v1/identities-index.json (built from taxonomy/identities; fields: slug, label, aliases, family label, sector label, kind, parent label). Budget ≤ 60 KB gzip.
identity_search.plural_stemming: Lower-case; on terms longer than 4 characters strip 'es' after sses/xes/ches/shes (classes→class, coaches→coach), otherwise strip a single trailing 's' unless the word ends in 'ss' (nurses→nurse, pastors→pastor). Apply to documents and queries.
identity_search.query_cleanup: Strip leading phrases: 'i am a', 'i'm a', 'im a', 'i am an', 'i'm an', 'i work as a', 'i work as an', 'as a', 'as an', 'for a', 'for an'.
ranking: exact label or alias match → position 1
parent professions before specialisms when scores tie
life roles after professions when scores tie

combined_query_rule.resolution: If the query contains ' for ' and the left part matches a registry tool name/slug exactly (case-insensitive) and the right part matches an identity (top identity result with score above threshold), the first suggestion is the route /for/{identity}/{tool}. Otherwise identities and content results are shown in separate groups.
